bears.name: Chicago Bears
bears.summary: The biggest recent story is quarterback Caleb Williams' hamstring injury suffered in the Bears' 9-3 loss to the Vikings, with head coach Ben Johnson not expecting him to practice this week but believing he could recover faster than expected, leaving some hope for a Week 3 return. Amid the injury news, the Bears also made roster moves this week, as the club signed LS Scott Daly to the active roster, signed DB Nick McCloud to the practice squad, and waived LS Beau Garner while releasing OL Kyle Hergel from the practice squad.

lions.name: Detroit Lions
lions.summary: The Detroit Lions are dealing with a depleted secondary after safety Avonte Maddox was ruled out for the season with a foot injury suffered in the 41-31 Week 2 loss to the Buffalo Bills, leaving Chuck Clark and Thomas Harper as the starting safeties alongside injured stars Kerby Joseph (knee) and Brian Branch (Achilles) on PUP. Maddox will undergo season-ending surgery for a left foot injury sustained during the loss to the Bills, and with both Kerby Joseph and Brian Branch on the reserve/PUP list, the Lions will turn to Chuck Clark and Thomas Harper as starting safeties.

packers.name: Green Bay Packers
packers.summary: The Green Bay Packers are dealing with a significant injury blow as right tackle Zach Bako-Bewele revealed he "fully tore" his patellar tendon on Sunday against the New York Jets , an injury that comes after he had previously partially torn the same tendon last year, which required surgery . The Packers, coming off their overtime win, are now shifting focus to Thursday's Week 3 home opener against the Atlanta Falcons at Lambeau Field.

vikings.name: Minnesota Vikings
vikings.summary: Kyler Murray has cleared the NFL's concussion protocol and will return as the Vikings' starting quarterback for Sunday's Week 3 game at the Tampa Bay Buccaneers, head coach Kevin O'Connell confirmed Monday. Murray takes back the reins from Carson Wentz, who was relieved by Wentz after Murray suffered a concussion on his 11th snap as a Viking, with Wentz helping Minnesota open the 2026 campaign with a 2-0 mark .
